calls.title: Genius Sports + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The meeting clarified key contacts and contract advancements, particularly establishing Sakib as the primary point for consent and CDP integration, with Gregory working to finalize the contract with David Williams. Important features of Growth Book were discussed, highlighting its unique open-source nature and compliance advantages for clients, particularly in the EU, with existing clients like Discord. The customer support model was noted for its responsiveness, providing dedicated access to engineers and rapid response times. Insights into the experimentation features showcased multi-armed bandits and AI analysis tools that enhance performance metrics. The internal dynamics at Genius regarding skepticism toward new software were a concern for further adoption, leading to a follow-up meeting to ensure internal consensus.
